sloka: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं बद्धं कपिवरोत्तमम् ।राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ।। ५.४८.५५।।।।
transliteration: taṁ mattamiva mātaṅgaṁ baddhaṁ kapivarottamam ।rākṣasā rākṣasendrāya rāvaṇāya nyavedayan ।। 5.48.55।।।।

translations.english: "Who is he? Whose son is he? Why has he come here? Where has he come from? What business does he have here?" Thus the heroic demons talked among themselves.
